breakdown.description: Dittus–Boelter (turbulent) correlation is applied in the laminar regime (Re=800).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the Dittus–Boelter correlation is inappropriate for laminar flow (Re=800). It replaced the incorrect turbulent flow correlation with the correct one for fully developed laminar flow with a constant surface temperature (Nu=3.66), which is the exact correction made in the ground truth.
